higher_coherence_interpretation: This is the sought analytic representation of the 3-cell: the two-variable Weyl identity has boundary equal to response minus reciprocal response and interior equal to the Poisson-pulled Green pairing. Its determinant cofactor is the scalar shadow, and its diagonal imaginary part is the positive apex.
next_iteration: Determine whether the source singular pencil admits the same identity as a selfadjoint linear relation with nonnegative weight P. Derive the weighted Weyl identity and identify the exact null-weight obstruction caused by the frozen source coordinate.
iteration_result: Conditional on a complete source boundary triple, the missing coherence equation is standard and exact: M(z)-M(w)^*=(z-conj(w))gamma(w)^*gamma(z). It simultaneously supplies reciprocal coherence, the determinant left/right cofactor tensor, positive Green energy, and seam confinement. The problem has moved entirely to constructing this identity for the actual singular source pencil and identifying its characteristic determinant with Xi.
